title: palicourea goyazensis

It is a medicinal plant native to the Amazon rainforest, used for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Palicourea goyazensis include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential to act as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressive agent.
